title: Read support ticket messages
description: Return a support ticket's message thread, ordered chronologically. The response is paginated (default 50, max 200 per page): use the limit and offset query params to page through long threads, and read count/next from the response envelope. The thread includes messages that were never sent to the customer, so read each message's message_type before you say what the team has sent to the customer. customer_message is written by the customer. sent_reply is a reply sent to the customer by a teammate, a workflow, or the AI. A sent_reply does not confirm delivery, because delivery can fail, so say the reply was sent, not that the customer received it. internal_note is a note for the team only. ai_draft is a reply or question the AI wrote for a teammate to review: it can read like a finished reply, but it was never sent, and a teammate may have sent their own version later as a separate sent_reply. internal_note and ai_draft messages both have is_private set to true. Never describe an internal_note or an ai_draft as sent to the customer.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
What the message is, and whether it was sent to the customer. customer_message: written by the customer. sent_reply: a reply sent to the customer by a teammate, a workflow or the AI. It does not confirm that the customer received it, because delivery can fail. internal_note: a note for the team only. It was never sent to the customer. ai_draft: a reply or question the AI wrote for a teammate to review. It was never sent to the customer.

* `customer_message` - Customer message
* `sent_reply` - Sent reply
* `internal_note` - Internal note
* `ai_draft` - AI draft
